title: fix(fields): clamp an out-of-range `scale` on the number cell and grid computeRow (#10071)
body:
Fixes #10071
Clause-②: no

## What

A declared `scale` above 100 is accepted by the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.4.0, but both `Intl.NumberFormat` and `Number.prototype.toFixed` refuse more than 100 fraction digits. Two readers passed it through unguarded:

- `NumberCellRenderer` (`packages/fields/src/index.tsx`) handed `scale` to `formatDisplayNumber` as `minimumFractionDigits` / `maximumFractionDigits`. The formatter's `catch` retries without the locale but with the same digits, so the `RangeError` escaped the render.
- `computeRow` (`packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx`) rounded a computed column with `Number(v.toFixed(scale))`. The column's `scale` comes from `deriveColumns` / `hydrateColumns` in `plugin-form`, which copy a child field's `scale` when the field has an `expression`. Editing a master-detail line therefore threw out of the edit.

Both now take the ruling objectui#9808 already made for the percent faces: a width the spec accepts and the engine refuses is clamped to 100 and reported once through `console.warn` (declared width, rendered width, card). `percent-scale.ts` stays module-private. Its clamp is generalized as `renderableFractionScale(declared, face, card)`, and `renderablePercentScale` delegates to it, so the percent diagnostic stays byte-identical. Nothing new is exported from a published entry. Negative, non-finite and non-integer widths keep their existing path, because the installed spec already refuses them (AGENTS.md #0.1).

`computeRow` is the only function touched in `GridField.tsx`, plus one import line. objectui#9909 edits other regions of the same file.

## Evidence

- Base red (fix absent, new pin present, BASE `62597c5`): `NumberScaleOutOfRange-10071.test.tsx` gave `Tests 4 failed | 8 passed (12)`. The failures were `RangeError: minimumFractionDigits value is out of range.` (cell) and `RangeError: toFixed() digits argument must be between 0 and 100` (computeRow). The 8 in-range, ceiling-inclusive and negative-width controls plus the spec-door controls passed, so they are lit.
- After, at head `2302cbe`: the five affected files (the new pin, the 9808 pin, both NumberCellRenderer suites, `GridField.test.tsx`) gave `Test Files 5 passed (5) · Tests 99 passed (99)`. The whole `packages/fields/` suite at `5a5911e` gave `Test Files 176 passed (176) · Tests 2988 passed (2988)`. The only later commit swaps two test-only casts.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/fields type-check` exits 0 after building the `@object-ui/fields^...` closure. `tsconfig.test.json --listFiles` includes both pin files.
- ESLint on the 5 changed source/test files: 0 errors.
- `check:new-line-citations` reports 0 new citations. `check:control-bytes`, `check:self-import` and `check:pending-changeset-literals` pass, and `check-changeset-presence` exits 0. `check:changeset-claims` is report-only: it flags pending changesets that name the edited files. I read them, and none is falsified, since `.scale` is still read in both files.
- The SUNSET row in the new pin asks the installed `FieldSchema` whether a computed number field with `scale: 101` is still accepted. The 9808 SUNSET message now names every importer of the module rather than "its two call sites".

## Acceptance notes

- The upstream bound is changeset `18972-field-scale-renderer-ceiling.md` on objectstack `main`, and it is unreleased. When objectui takes a spec with that bound, both SUNSET rows go red and the clamp module and its importers are to be deleted.
